text: トレーナータワー　いりぐち　つよき　トレーナーよ　かけあがれ！

structure.jp: トレーナータワー　いりぐち
つよき　トレーナーよ

patterns.name: 〜き
patterns.span: つよき　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: き in place of い is an old, grand-sounding ending for a describing word placed before a thing. It is used on signs and in slogans. つよき　トレーナー = 'strong Trainers'.

patterns.name: 〜よ (calling)
patterns.explanation: よ right after a person is a grand, old-style way of calling out to them, like 'O ...'. トレーナーよ = 'O Trainers'.

patterns.name: 〜え (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to an え sound makes a blunt order. かけあがる is 'to run up', so かけあがれ = 'run up!'.
